verdict.rationale: Browser Use is a browser agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Browser Use running as an MCP server that other clients such as Claude or Cursor connect to. Nothing shows Browser Use itself connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
